reports.headline: Livestock Lost in the Night
reports.body: {name} lost three {animal} overnight in the grazing land {dir} of the village {dist}. No tracks, no wolves heard. What was left had been worried at, not eaten. The dogs refuse to go out that way after dark, and {name} has taken to bringing the rest in before sunset.

reports.headline: Strange Sounds From the Pasture
reports.body: Several households report a buzzing, like a hive kicked over, from the fields {dir} of here {dist}. {name} went out with a lantern and came back with nothing to say except that something had been at the {animal}. The fencing is intact.

reports.headline: Dogs Won't Go Near the Lower Field
reports.body: The dogs that guard the grazing land {dir} of the village {dist} have taken to lying in the road and whining rather than go out to it. {name} found the {animal} huddled in one corner of the fence at dawn, all of them facing the same empty patch of grass. The trough there has been knocked over three nights running.

reports.headline: A Ring of Dead Grass in the Pasture
reports.body: Overnight a ring of grass has gone grey and brittle in the pasture {dir} of here {dist}, wide as a cart is long. {name} lost one of the {animal} inside it and swears the others will not step over the edge. Something has been buzzing there after dark; nobody has gone out with a lantern since.
